scenarios.name: document_page_size_waits_for_stylesheet
scenarios.title: Print the document's 90x54mm card while its stylesheet is pending
scenarios.workflow: Real Chrome CLI launch -> navigation without waiting -> pending real HTTP stylesheet -> print document CSS size -> inspect actual vector PDF and loaded same page -> owned stop
scenarios.user_problem: Printing a still-loading stylesheet silently creates a Letter PDF instead of the document's declared physical size.

scenarios.name: preset_page_size_waits_for_stylesheet
scenarios.title: Apply the 90x54mm preset after the document's different print stylesheet loads
scenarios.workflow: Real Chrome CLI launch -> pending 140x80mm stylesheet -> request card-cn -> inspect actual 90x54mm vector PDF -> verify injected rule removed -> owned stop
scenarios.user_problem: The requested exact preset must win after document styles load, with no silently rounded fallback.

scenarios.name: explicit_units_wait_for_stylesheet
scenarios.title: Print exact explicit metric units after real pending styles complete
scenarios.workflow: Real Chrome CLI launch -> pending real stylesheet -> request 90mm x 54mm -> inspect MediaBox and reported trim -> same ready page without temporary style -> owned stop
scenarios.user_problem: An explicit physical trim must survive slow page loading and report the dimensions that actually landed.
